description: Follow a finding to get its notifications, or stop following it. Requires write permission and acts as the API key creator. The assignee always follows their finding and can't unfollow it.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

follow.description: True to follow the finding, false to stop following it.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: follow_finding
title: Follow or unfollow a finding
